links.rationale: Both refute nominal amplification because unrestricted reuse allows many local pieces to be represented by a small global coding/separation scheme.
Both expose hidden low-dimensional representations of a large graph family: coordinate cylinders in C011 and quotient/twin classes in C013.
Both are constructive compression warnings: apparent global structure does not matter if an explicit low-cost representation compiles to a cover.
The combination of cheap constructive covers and structure-blind scalar failure motivates O9d12a2a1: move from target-first statistics to a cyclic-operation-aware potential with a local budget.
